record.name: Echani
record.description: The Echani are a humanoid species from the planet Eshan, known for their distinctive silver-white hair, pale skin, and their natural talent for combat and martial arts. They are skilled warriors and bodyguards, often working as mercenaries, guards, or martial artists. Their species has a natural affinity for unarmed combat and physical discipline.

innate_traits.name: Martial Arts Training
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has spent generations perfecting the art of unarmed combat. Every Echani is born with an innate understanding of martial arts, making you a natural master of hand-to-hand combat and physical discipline.

mechanics.name: Unarmed Strike Proficiency
mechanics.description: You gain proficiency in unarmed strikes.

mechanics.name: Dexterity-Based Strikes
mechanics.description: You can use your Dexterity modifier for attack and damage rolls with unarmed strikes.

innate_traits.name: Combat Discipline
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has developed incredible discipline and focus in combat situations. You can read your opponents' movements and anticipate their attacks with uncanny precision, making you exceptionally difficult to surprise or overwhelm.

mechanics.name: Combat Analysis
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks when analyzing combat situations or opponents.

innate_traits.name: Combat Communication
innate_traits.narrative: Your species has evolved to communicate through combat, reading emotions and intentions through fighting styles. This unique form of communication allows you to understand others in ways that transcend language.

mechanics.name: Combat Insight
mechanics.description: You have advantage on Insight checks to read emotions during combat.

mechanics.name: Sparring Communication
mechanics.description: Once per short rest, you can gain advantage on a Charisma check by engaging in a brief sparring match.

appearance_profile.llm_description_prompt: Describe an Echani character. Emphasize their distinctive silver-white hair and pale skin that gives them an almost ethereal appearance, and their disciplined, martial bearing that reflects their natural talent for combat and martial arts. Their stance should be combat-ready and controlled, suggesting someone who has mastered the art of unarmed combat. Consider their honorable nature and the way they carry themselves with the confident, disciplined bearing of someone who communicates through combat and understands the language of fighting.

class_synergies.narrative: Echani's natural Martial Arts Training and Combat Discipline make them exceptional Monks, able to master unarmed combat and read opponents with perfect precision.
mechanical_benefits: Martial Arts Training trait provides natural unarmed combat abilities
Combat Discipline trait enhances opponent analysis
Combat Communication trait improves combat-based social interaction

class_synergies.narrative: Echani's natural protective instincts and martial abilities make them excellent Guardians, using their combat discipline to protect others with honor and skill.
mechanical_benefits: Martial Arts Training trait provides defensive capabilities
Combat Discipline trait enhances protective awareness
Combat Communication trait aids in understanding threats

class_synergies.narrative: Echani's natural combat abilities and martial training make them excellent Soldiers, able to fight with discipline and honor in any situation.
mechanical_benefits: Martial Arts Training trait enhances combat effectiveness
Combat Discipline trait improves tactical awareness
Combat Communication trait supports team coordination

class_synergies.narrative: Echani's natural combat abilities and disciplined nature make them excellent Scouts, able to navigate and fight with martial precision.
mechanical_benefits: Combat Discipline trait enables precise navigation and observation
Martial Arts Training trait provides self-defense capabilities
Combat Communication trait aids in team coordination

faction_synergies.narrative: Echani are highly valued by mercenary companies for their natural martial abilities, combat discipline, and honorable reputation as skilled warriors.
Many Echani work for security organizations as bodyguards and protectors, using their natural martial abilities and combat discipline.
Many Echani prefer to work as independent warriors and martial artists, using their natural abilities to serve causes they believe in with honor and discipline.

level_5.description: Your martial arts training becomes more refined, allowing you to read opponents and anticipate their moves with even greater precision.
level_5.mechanical_benefit: You can use your reaction to gain advantage on your next attack roll against a creature you've successfully analyzed in combat.

level_10.description: Your combat discipline reaches new heights, allowing you to maintain perfect focus and control in any combat situation.
level_10.mechanical_benefit: You can use your action to gain advantage on all Dexterity-based skill checks for the next minute when in combat or martial training.

level_15.description: Your martial arts mastery allows you to channel your combat discipline into devastating attacks.
level_15.mechanical_benefit: When using unarmed strikes, you gain a +2 bonus to attack rolls and damage rolls, representing your enhanced martial arts mastery.

level_20.description: Your combat discipline reaches its peak, making you nearly impossible to surprise or control in combat.
level_20.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all saving throws against being surprised or charmed, and you can use your reaction to make an unarmed strike against any creature that attempts to grapple you.

narrative_progression.level_5: You begin to master your martial arts techniques, becoming a formidable opponent in combat. Your training focuses on refining your skills and developing a deeper connection with your body.
narrative_progression.level_10: As you progress, you become increasingly skilled at reading the battlefield and anticipating your opponents' moves. You start to develop a reputation as a reliable and deadly warrior.
narrative_progression.level_15: You've reached a new level of mastery, able to execute complex martial techniques with precision and ease. Your confidence in combat grows, and you begin to take on more leadership roles within your community.
narrative_progression.level_20: At the pinnacle of your abilities, you embody the Echani ideals of discipline, honor, and combat prowess. You're a master strategist and tactician, able to adapt to any situation with ease.

cultural_features.description: Echani have sacred martial rituals that celebrate their combat heritage and honor the traditions of unarmed combat.
cultural_features.name: Martial Rituals
cultural_features.activation: Triggered by significant martial achievements or milestones (e.g., defeating a challenging opponent, mastering a new technique).
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You feel a deep connection to your Echani heritage as you participate in a sacred martial ritual. Your focus and discipline are heightened, granting you advantage on all skill checks related to combat.

cultural_features.description: Echani combat traditions emphasize discipline, honor, and the importance of mastering the art of unarmed combat.
cultural_features.name: Combat Traditions
cultural_features.activation: Triggered by engaging in combat or martial training with a respected mentor or peer.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You draw upon your Echani heritage as you face your opponent. Your focus is sharpened, and you sense opportunities for growth and improvement.

cultural_features.description: Echani communities gather in sparring circles to practice martial arts, share techniques, and strengthen their bonds through combat.
cultural_features.name: Sparring Circles
cultural_features.activation: Triggered by participating in a sparring session with other members of the community.
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You connect with your fellow Echani as you engage in a spirited sparring match. Your skills improve, and you develop new techniques through shared learning.

cultural_features.description: Echani practice meditation techniques that enhance their combat focus and martial discipline.
cultural_features.name: Combat Meditation
cultural_features.activation: Triggered by engaging in meditation or mindfulness exercises before a significant martial event (e.g., a high-stakes competition, a critical mission).
cultural_features.narrative_enhancement: You quiet your mind and focus on the present moment. Your senses are heightened, allowing you to anticipate threats and opportunities with greater ease.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your martial arts training makes you perfectly suited for combat environments, where you can read and respond to threats with incredible precision.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on all skill checks in combat environments, and you can sense the presence of hidden threats within 30 feet.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your natural discipline allows you to maintain focus and control in any environment, regardless of distractions or chaos.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on saving throws against being distracted or losing focus, and you can maintain concentration in chaotic situations.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your martial arts training allows you to thrive in environments that require physical discipline and combat skills.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Dexterity-based skill checks in martial environments, and you can sense opportunities for combat training.

environmental_adaptations.description: Your species' emphasis on honor and discipline allows you to navigate complex social situations with grace and integrity.
environmental_adaptations.mechanical_benefit: You have advantage on Charisma-based skill checks when acting with honor and integrity, and you can sense when others are acting dishonorably.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: Echani warrior with silver-white hair and pale skin, standing in a defensive stance.

record.flavor_text: The Echani are known for their unwavering dedication to the art of combat. Their homeworld, Eshan, is a planet where martial prowess is revered as a sacred tradition. From a young age, Echani children are trained in the ways of combat and physical discipline, often being enrolled in prestigious academies that teach them the finer points of hand-to-hand combat, sword fighting, and defensive techniques. The Echani's natural affinity for unarmed combat makes them formidable opponents on any battlefield.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: As an Echani, you are deeply connected to your martial heritage. Your culture emphasizes discipline, self-control, and respect for your opponents. You may find yourself drawn to roles that require strategic thinking, physical prowess, or leadership. Be mindful of your own emotional control, as the Echani are known for their calm and focused demeanor in combat.
narrative_hooks: Your family's honor is tied to your martial performance. How will you live up to your family's expectations?
You've been tasked with protecting a high-ranking dignitary from an assassination attempt. Can you keep them safe?
llm_guidance.social_dynamics: Echani tend to be respectful and courteous, but also fiercely competitive in combat situations. They value loyalty and camaraderie with their comrades, often forming strong bonds through shared experiences.
common_motivations: To prove oneself as a skilled warrior
To protect one's family or community
To master the art of combat and become a legendary fighter

ai_behavior.personality: Warm, yet reserved; your Echani character is a trusted and formidable ally. They value loyalty above all else.
motivations: Seeking new knowledge in martial arts
ai_behavior.combat_behavior: Your Echani character excels at close-range combat, focusing on disabling opponents with precision strikes rather than aiming for a kill shot.
ai_behavior.social_behavior: In social situations, your Echani character is respectful and courteous, but also fiercely protective of their allies and territory.

trust_levels.Friendly (0-50): Treats the companion as an equal in combat and respects their expertise

trust_levels.Trusted (51-75): Collaborates closely with the companion in social situations and respects their opinion

trust_levels.Honored (76-100): Places their trust entirely in the companion, following their lead in all situations

loyalty_triggers: Disrespect towards martial arts or personal honor

nemesis_motivations: Crush the Echani's martial traditions and assert their own power
Eliminate any potential threats to their authority
nemesis_tactics: Use overwhelming force to overwhelm Echani defenses
Exploit Echani weaknesses in close combat

overrides.cultural_approach: Echani typically view romantic relationships as a secondary priority, focusing first on their martial duties and family obligations. However, when they do form connections with others, it is often deeply passionate and intense.
ideal_partners: Those who share a deep respect for Echani traditions
romance_tactics: Use physical discipline to create a bond of trust and intimacy
Engage in respectful competition to prove one's worth
